snippet.title: Trash to Trees: Tidy Up the Forest! | Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Trash to Trees: Tidy up the forest! is a cozy first-person tidy-up and restoration game where you turn a polluted forest back into a thriving natural environment.

Pick up thousands of trash items, bring them back to the recycling station, sort everything into the correct categories, and earn money to improve your equipment.

As you progress, you can carry larger hauls, pick up multiple items at once, expand your sorting setup, and scan the forest to find those last few pieces hiding away.

As you pick up each piece of trash, watch the forest become less polluted and nature slowly return.

10,000+ trash items. One forest to restore.

Our Steam page is live if you'd like to check it out.

Wishlist on Steam:
